content:
We are back this week to update you on the latest additions to Apple's official certified refurbished store. This week's highlights include the MacBook Neo, brand new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

Apple's certified refurbished store is an excellent way to purchase products on Apple's official website while saving up to 15%.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Quality products at attractive prices
  • Undergo a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Backed by Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products can be purchased additionally
  • Engraving services and gift packaging are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and removal from the Apple certified refurbished store so you don't have to. Inventory changes quickly, and the purpose of this article is to keep you informed about currently available products so you can purchase your desired items before they sell out.

Mac computers

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air prices remain my favourite deals. Both are excellent choices for first-time entrants into the Apple ecosystem, or for those upgrading to a product equipped with an Apple Silicon chip.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo (256GB storage): $599 (originally $699 new)
  • MacBook Neo (512GB storage with Touch ID): $679 (originally $799 new)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (1TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,529 (originally $1,799 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (2TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,949 (originally $2,299 new)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac (256GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,439 (originally $1,699 new)

Studio Display

We first mentioned a few weeks ago that the Studio Display XDR is available through the Apple refurbished store. As we often remind you, inventory changes can happen quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR (standard glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $2,799 (originally $3,299 new)
  • Studio Display XDR (nano-texture glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $3,059 (originally $3,599 new)

Apple TV 4K

The much-anticipated base-model Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, along with the higher-end version featuring Ethernet connectivity. The base model typically sells out quickly, so if you're looking to buy, don't hesitate.

  • Apple TV 4K (third generation, 64GB storage, Wi-Fi): $169 (originally $199 new)
  • Apple TV 4K (third generation, 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet): $209 (originally $249 new)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you'd like to join me, here are some great deals from the Apple refurbished store this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black ocean band: $679 (originally $799 new)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with anchor blue ocean band: $679 (originally $799 new)

As always, you can stay on top of all the latest Apple deals this week at 9to5Toys.
